record_refinements.behavior_append: Registered anonymous goal inherits this exact custom RangedAttackGoal;its continuation override uses canUse(),not the base continuation fallback. canUse captures current live target. Constructor duplicates the single interval into min/max,sets attackTime=-1,owns MOVE/LOOK flags and stores radius plus its float square. Each tick uses current target XYZ/LOS;seeTime increments with LOS and otherwise resets0. Navigation stops only at squared distance<=radiusSquared AND seeTime>=5,otherwise moves toward target at native speed. Look control receives30/30. Native predecrement attackTime:when zero,missing LOS writes SHOOT=false and returns WITHOUT clock reset;with LOS writes SHOOT=true BEFORE exactly one existing performRangedAttack(target,clamp(float(sqrt(distanceSquared))/radius,.1F,1F)). There is no additional attack-radius rejection in that firing arm. Post-fire clock=floor(float ratio*(max-min)+min);negative clock=floor(lerp(double ratio,min,max));other positive ticks write SHOOT=false. stop clears target/seeTime,sets clock=-1 and SHOOT=false. Already locked factories ignore flval;no new projectile,damage/status contribution,owner/team predicate or hurt-return gate is created. Native goal scheduling,registration values and binary SHOOT state remain recorded context,not a duplicate payload parameter or Stage-policy decision. Concrete interval=100,radius=10.0,speed=1.25. SpiderSnatcher makeStuckInBlock rejects precisely native COBWEB;otherwise forwards original state/vector to Monster. This binary environment gate is not damage or a new velocity contribution.
